subject: C Programming & Systems Fundamentals
board: WBCHSE / ICSE / CBSE / BCA / B.Tech / Gate

projects.title: Dynamic 2D Matrix Memory Allocator & Deallocator
projects.description: Implement safe dynamic allocation and complete deallocation of an R x C 2D matrix on the heap via double and triple pointers.
projects.exampleOutput:
Dynamic 3x4 Matrix Created on Heap:
  [ 11 12 13 14 ]
  [ 21 22 23 24 ]
  [ 31 32 33 34 ]
✓ Matrix memory completely deallocated. Pointer is now: (nil)
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Allocate array of row pointers, then allocate column elements per row.
2. In freeMatrix, deallocate each row before freeing the master pointer array, and set caller pointer to NULL.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates heap memory management, double/triple pointer parameter indirection, and memory rollback on allocation failure.

projects.title: Higher-Order Generic Array Filter and Map Engine
projects.description: Build functional programming filter and map higher-order routines in C accepting function pointer callbacks and predicate filters.
projects.exampleOutput:
1. Filter (Positive Only): [ 12 7 8 14 21 ]
2. Filter (Even Only): [ 12 8 14 -2 ]
3. Map (Squared Evens): [ 144 64 196 4 ]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Define PredicateFunc returning bool and TransformFunc returning int.
2. Apply callbacks iteratively across array elements.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates functional programming paradigms, higher-order functions, and callback patterns in C.

projects.title: Generic Byte-by-Byte Memory Hex Dump & Endianness Inspector
projects.description: Inspect raw hexadecimal byte representation of any variable in RAM and detect CPU architecture byte ordering (Little vs Big Endian).
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Test least significant byte of 0x0001 to detect Little-Endian.
2. Cast generic void* to const uint8_t* to iterate memory bytes.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates hardware-level memory architecture analysis, bit layouts, and low-level byte casting.

projects.title: Pointer-based String Tokenizer & In-Place Parser
projects.description: Re-implement thread-safe custom_strtok_r using double pointers to maintain state across calls without global static memory.
projects.exampleOutput:
Field 1: '2026-09-02'
Field 2: 'INFO'
Field 3: 'Barrackpore Center'
Field 4: 'Student Admissions Opened'
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Use double pointer saveptr to save current string index.
2. Overwrite delimiter with '\0' in-place and advance saveptr.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates thread-safe tokenization and double pointer context state management.

projects.title: Dynamic Array Stack with Auto-Resizing via realloc
projects.description: Implement a dynamic LIFO stack structure that doubles its capacity automatically on the heap using realloc.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Check top >= capacity.
2. Reallocate buffer using realloc with doubled capacity and update pointer.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates dynamic data structures, realloc memory growth, and LIFO stack mechanics.

projects.title: Polymorphic Generic Sort Comparator Engine
projects.description: Build a universal sorting function that sorts arrays of ANY data type using void* buffers and (const void*, const void*) comparators.
projects.exampleText: Sort integer array [78, 12, 95, 34, 56] and double array [99.99, 12.50, 45.00, 5.25]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Offset addresses using byte arithmetic: (char*)base + index * elemSize.
2. Swap bytes using temp buffer via memcpy.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates generic polymorphic algorithms using void pointers and memcpy byte swapping.

projects.title: In-Place Array Cyclic Rotator using Pure Pointer Arithmetic
projects.description: Rotate an array to the right by K positions using pointer ranges without using bracket indexing.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Reverse range using two pointers start and end.
2. Apply 3-step reversal on array pointer boundaries.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates pure pointer arithmetic, range boundaries, and O(1) space rotation.

projects.title: Function Pointer Event Dispatcher & State Machine Engine
projects.description: Implement a finite state machine (FSM) using an array of function pointer state handlers.
projects.exampleText: States: IDLE -> RUNNING -> PAUSED -> RUNNING -> STOPPED
projects.exampleOutput:
Step 1 -> State: [IDLE]
Step 2 -> State: [RUNNING]...
Step 5 -> State: [STOPPED]
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Define State enum and array of function pointers.
2. Invoke stateHandlers[state]() directly in O(1) time.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates finite state machines and event dispatch tables in embedded C.

projects.title: Linked List Head Insertion & Deletion Engine via Double Pointers
projects.description: Implement singly linked list head insertion and deletion routines that mutate the caller's head pointer using Node**.
projects.exampleText: Insert 10, 20, 30 at head, then delete head
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Pass &head (type Node**) to update caller's head pointer directly.
2. Free memory safely and update links.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates linked data structures, heap node allocation, and pointer-to-pointer head mutations.

projects.title: Arithmetic Expression Evaluator using Operator Dispatch Table
projects.description: Evaluate binary math expressions dynamically using a function pointer dispatch table mapped by operator symbol.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. Map operator char symbol to binary function pointer in a dispatch table.
2. Look up symbol and execute handler.
projects.codeExplanation: Demonstrates table-driven parsing and dispatch architectures.
